counterexample.discovery: Discovered before activation; no MCP mutation dispatched.
counterexample.defect_mechanism: admission.gleam:243 and 266 construct raw coordinator resource keys as 'task:' <> scope.plan <> '/' <> scope.task (e.g. 'task:uos/harness-admission-repair/20260909-1751/ADMISSION'). However, uos_swarm/session_sync.gleam:valid_resource passes the task suffix to identifier(), which explicitly restricts characters to [a-zA-Z0-9-_.:] and excludes forward slash (/). Consequently, valid_resource returns false on this key expression, and coordinator lease claims/releases fail-closed with invalid_resource.
counterexample.remediation: Unify coordinator resource generation via shared dev.task_resource, hashing the canonical JSON {'plan': plan, 'task': task} into 'task:' <> digest (where hex digits are strictly within [a-f0-9]), while retaining human-readable execution labels in receipts. Add a regression test calling the real coordinator validator and confirming separation of identical task names across different plans.
counterexample.impact_on_grant: v7 grant proposal cannot be activated. The impending fix modifies admission.gleam, development.gleam, and operations.gleam, invalidating the v7 loaded_control_ids and source digests.

findings: COUNTEREXAMPLE CONFIRMED: uos_swarm/session_sync.gleam:identifier restricts character sets to [a-zA-Z0-9-_.:], rejecting slashes. The direct construction 'task:' <> plan <> '/' <> task in admission.gleam:243 and 266 produces invalid coordinator resource identifiers that would be refused upon live claim.
Remediation through shared dev.task_resource hashing canonical JSON {'plan': plan, 'task': task} is sound and prevents both slash rejection and cross-plan task name aliasing.
The v7 grant proposal var/harness/20260909-1751-admission-grant-proposal.json is preserved as NOT_ACTIVATED / REVISE.
Final approval of loaded_control_ids is withheld pending Root's compilation of the resource key fix, generation of new build/test receipts (v8), and authoring of grant proposal v8.
